claims.statement: For uniform full-size P-256 Q=[x]P, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 under the disclosed H1 (extended to the small-key y-window adder table), M1/L-ori conditional fresh-exposure, H3 pricing and H-trail (average correction count per trail, with the fold model for dy) premises. Total charged work is at most 2^126.731792 units at C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions/unit. Analytic bound, not an executed attack. A=2^27, K=2^32, tau=0.4943092, residual Markov factor 400000, batches of 2^29 walks. Adders have Montgomery x in [2^192,2^231) and y within p/2 +- 2^-8 p, at most 2^40 fresh trials per adder with worst-case work charged. The field-step map is unchanged; distinguished points have canonical key < 2^196, theta=2^196/p, tested by one top-limb tst rather than extr and tst, so trail endpoints change. The slot is (key >> 27) mod C, uniform on 2^169 inputs under M1 before reduction, DP_MAX=2*ceil(S*theta)+2*K; the DP path skips the anchor comparison and the fix block preserves the canonical top limb through the y fix and re-runs the correct predicate. Inherited fixed/rare-path changes, charged below: `finv` is 4-bit windowed (253 squarings and 39 multiplications instead of 255 and 127), saving 11,814 instructions per round; the 2^60 anchor cap is one `tbnz x12,#60`, so anchor rounds add 3*(2^29-1)+9; every unbatched rare-path addition shares `finv`, so F_MAX falls 41,190 -> 29,376 and wL 2,789,700 -> 2,021,790; rounds with t mod 64 = 0 compare against the old anchor and rewrite it, rounds with 1 <= t mod 64 <= 32 use a tail without the anchor load and comparison, and rounds with 33 <= t mod 64 <= 63 keep the plain comparison, with the skip tail removing `ldr x6` and `ccmp` per copy, 2*(2^29-1)-2 instructions per skip round, and the arm dispatch charged +3 plain, +2 skip and -1 anchor. Every cycle of length l<=32 reaches a tested offset among the 32 consecutive offsets 33..64, a cycle of length 33<=l<=64 is tested at offset l, and the resulting at most 128 persistent steps are already charged. An escape depends on the cycle's classes; replays and the reduced-order experiment retain every-step comparisons, a superset of the live schedule. Sixteenth change: both per-pass blocks hold sixteen copies, so each end test runs B/16 times instead of B/8 (B/4 fewer per round) and the entry dispatch gains one bit test (measured +2); every copy body, tail, slow block and rare path is byte-identical, and no cap, meter or premise changes. It is the census 577.25*B + 28,904, exact at B=2^20 and the ledger's only law in BATCH. Fixed plain work is charged 309,908,762,856 instructions per 2^29-walk round; the anchor arm adds 3*(2^29-1)+9-1 and the skip arm subtracts 2*(2^29-1)-2, both plus a 1,024*BATCH/2^20 instruction allowance per round. C_COMMON is at most 576.298032, CORR at most 14.210693, total step charge at most 590.516314 instructions. branchy.json checkpoints are in the base submissions, omitted here for the size limit. The shorter fix path gets no correction credit: xy_fix stays charged 47 against the measured 45, C_MAX 123, exits 13. Measurements are emulated instruction counts, not production success evidence: both seeds at 2^16 show -(B-1) per round, anchors fall by the same amount; all three arms fall by exactly B/4-2 per round at B=A=2^16 and 2^20 on seed 1 with identical correction meters and byte-identical dumps; 2.4M compiled-tail cases agree with exact models, and paired anchor-skip measurements at B=2^16 (rounds 1, 33, 64) and B=2^20 (round 1) reproduce the arm model exactly. All preprocessing, failures, restarts, table initialization, lookup, transfers, replay, verification and output are charged. Peak memory under 2^77 bytes, preprocessing at most 2^84.961190 units, zero nonuniform advice. Conditional success lower bound exceeds 0.39000025 (about 0.390003363); the full production collision and correction premises remain heuristics. Inherited reduced-order experiments retain the old DP predicate and support only their disclosed scope. probability.md replaces the selected-merge tail by a 1.3e-6 all-abandonment envelope and derives report overflow from distinct first exposures; the small-failure bucket is 2^-59, not the old unallocated 2^-20, all under the shared per-class M1 environment, common-phase continuation, worst-case rare debits and first-duplicate termination.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the revised full production cost ledger (including the correction charge, its meter slack and abort term) and order certificate, then run the inherited complete reduced-order procedure, with checkpoint-only cycle detection and the small-key adder key rule at toy scale (adder_key_shift 2: adders redrawn until key < p>>2; shift 4 exceeded the runner's time limit; no y window), at tau=0.4943, the production value on its 0.0001 grid, retaining failures and replay checks. The two results have distinct scopes; neither establishes production mixing.
